rule_title: TTP 1563.002 - RDP Session Hijacking via tscon.exe
description: Detects RDP session hijacking using tscon.exe to redirect a disconnected or active session to the attacker's own RDP channel. tscon running as SYSTEM (SubjectUserSid S-1-5-18) with a /dest: argument is the execution fingerprint; the follow-on EID 4778 confirms the victim session was reconnected under the attacker's client. Covers both delivery methods: direct SYSTEM shell execution and service-based execution via sc.exe.

steps.description: Victim session reconnects to attacker client confirming successful hijack
